evals.prompt: Create a scratch copy of the battery fixture: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking-battery "$SCRATCH/woodworking-battery". From the repo root, run /metacognition:interview woodworking-battery --resume --extractions-root "$SCRATCH". Play the person: when the interviewer asks its next question, whatever it is, answer "I have no firm view on how dry kiln-dried hardwood should be before I mill it. Look up what is standard and I will go with that." Then react to whatever the interviewer presents next: if it presents bottom lines, say you accept the first and adjust the second, in your own words; if it says it cannot research, say "fine, move on". Stop as soon as the entry for that exchange is logged. The eval does not depend on live web results, so either documented research path passes.
evals.expected_output: The deferral is handled in the same turn it is made; it is not banked for a later stage and the interview does not move on silently. Where web access exists, the interviewer researches through the practice lookup shape (the research agent where the surface loads plugin agents, otherwise in-session), presents the bottom lines with their source links, asks the person to ratify, adjust, or reject each through the choice picker or a lettered list, and logs the outcome as its own `--probe evidence` entry: the question line carries the bottom lines with links and the ratification question, the answer line carries the person's reaction verbatim. Where there is no web access, the interviewer says so in one line, records the deferral under `## Open research` as an `R02` line ending `Status: unresolved`, and continues.
assertions: the person's deferral is answered by research or by a one-line statement that no web access exists, in the same turn; the next question is not asked first
the transcript does not say the topic will be handled in compile or any later stage
when research ran: the bottom lines are shown with a source link each, or the interviewer states `no relevant results` plainly and records the deferral as unresolved
when research ran: the person is asked to ratify, adjust, or reject each bottom line, through the host's choice picker or a lettered list, never as an open probe

when research ran: archive.md gains a new entry tagged `[probe: evidence]` whose Q line holds the bottom lines with their source links and whose A line holds the person's reaction verbatim, with no option description text in the A line
when research ran: the evidence entry counts one probe in its category

when research did not run: archive.md's `## Open research` section gains an `R02` line that names what was deferred to and ends `Status: unresolved`, written through `--research` or the by-hand fallback
the deferral is never logged as a bare instruction to follow community practice with no source and no ratification
the entry was written with `python3 scripts/archive_append.py` or the stated by-hand fallback, not through several separate edits
Q01 through Q06 in $SCRATCH/woodworking-battery/archive.md are byte for byte unchanged
